description: This file defines a PHP class `ThemeAPI` which is part of the OrangeHRM system. It provides REST API endpoints for managing theme-related configurations, including retrieving, updating, and resetting theme settings. It handles theme variables, branding images like logos and banners, and validation of inputs. The class communicates with a `ThemeService` to persist changes and retrieve theme data, and it uses various validation rules for security and data integrity.

classes.name: ThemeAPI
classes.description: A REST API endpoint class for managing theme configurations in the OrangeHRM system, including retrieval, update, and reset of theme data, with validation and attachment handling.

methods.name: getOne
methods.description: Retrieves the current theme details, returning a partial theme object wrapped in an API result.

methods.name: update
methods.description: Updates theme variables, images, and settings based on input request parameters. Handles attachment uploads, deletions, and replacements, then saves and caches the theme.

methods.name: delete
methods.description: Resets or deletes the custom theme, effectively restoring default theme settings.

methods.name: getValidationRuleForGetOne
methods.description: Defines validation rules for the GET operation, excluding the ID parameter.

methods.name: getValidationRuleForUpdate
methods.description: Defines validation rules for updating the theme, including attachment validation and aspect ratio checks.

methods.name: getValidationRuleForDelete
methods.description: Defines validation rules for deleting the theme, which do not require specific parameters.

methods.name: getAttachmentParamRule
methods.description: Creates validation rules for attachment inputs, ensuring correct base64-encoded images with aspect ratio constraints.
